title: Senior Backend Engineer, AI Agents
description:
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to contribute to our vision and development of Agentic AI tooling and platforms through technical leadership and proactive thinking. Our product is an orchestration platform that enables developers to spin up isolated, AI-powered development sessions that autonomously work on tasks - from Jira tickets to GitHub issues. The team operates without a dedicated product manager; you will be expected to identify problems worth solving, define requirements, and own features from problem statement to production deployment.

Our technical stack spans Rust for CLI tools and API server, React 19 with TypeScript for our frontend, and Kubernetes with Helm on Google Cloud for infrastructure. You will work across this entire stack, leveraging the agentic tooling we build ourselves to contribute effectively beyond your primary domain. Your specialization in backend development - API design, async web frameworks, authentication, databases, and service architecture - will make you the team’s anchor for the API server and backend systems, but you will regularly touch frontend code and infrastructure as the work demands.

The team operates in a startup fashion with a heavy focus on experimentation and prototyping solutions first and evaluating what works in practice rather than heavy upfront requirements given how quickly the agentic space moves.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Make decisions based on multiple quality dimensions like user impact, failure tolerance, code maintenance, implementation time, security breaches, and performance.
  • Implement quality gates and improve agentic-driven processes and workflows.
  • Collaborate on novel ideas to improve the team processes.
  • Lead initiatives and own subproducts and feature development from problem statement and specification to production deployment.
  • Care for and monitor the quality of our product.
  • Raise awareness of technical issues.
  • Develop a clear understanding of business value and collaborate with stakeholders by analyzing features and suggesting alternatives.
  • Assist our platform and tooling’s users with their issues and resolve bugs they may experience.
  • Proactively identify technical debt and product areas that require attention or improvements and suggest improvements in our technology stack.
  • Mentor fellow teammates.
  • Bring up difficult and/or systemic challenges and impediments to the attention of your manager.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Solid 8+ years of software development experience, of which:
  • 5+ years with systems‑level or backend technologies such as Rust, Go, NodeJS, Python, Ruby, or Java.
  • Experience with async web frameworks (Axum, Actix, Warp, Tokio ecosystem, or equivalent in other languages) is required.
  • Experience with databases (PostgreSQL preferred) and caching layers (Redis) is required.
  • Experience with authentication/authorization systems (OAuth 2.0, JWT, OIDC) is required.
  • Experience with WebSocket or real‑time communication protocols is required.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (GCP preferred, AWS/Azure acceptable) is a plus.
  • Experience with frontend technologies such as React is a plus.
  • Have adopted agentic development tool & practices for routine work and personal automation projects, such as Claude Code, Codex, Gemini‑cli, OpenCode, pi‑agent or others.
  • Strong knowledge of functional and object‑oriented programming, automated software testing, development, and testing essential methodologies.
  • Ability to consider multiple quality dimensions like risk assessment, user impact, failure tolerance, code maintenance, implementation time, security breaches, and performance.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Thriving in autonomy in every aspect of daily work - be able to unblock yourself by finding the right people or help.
  • Being a team player by avoiding solo performances and unblocking your peers.
  • Caring for quality through impactful tests, process change proposals, and raising awareness of issues, be they product or technical.
  • Caring for architecture - applying best practices, using software design patterns, and bringing ideas for improvements.
  • Comfortable operating with high autonomy — you identify what needs building, not just how to build it.
  • You must be a world‑class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

title: Sr. Finance Systems Analyst
description:
Position Summary

The Senior Finance Analyst – Clinical Solutions Portfolio is a strategic, business-partnering role responsible for portfolio-level financial analysis across Clinical Solutions departments. The primary focus is project and portfolio financial health, including forecasting, budget performance, and financial controls, with an expanding remit into trial operations KPIs and measures as they relate to budget integrity, scope control, and delivery efficiency.

The role requires a strong background in Project Finance within a CRO environment , excellent analytical and presentation skills, and the ability to engage credibly with department heads and senior operational leaders.

Main Duties & Responsibilities

  • Own and deliver portfolio-level financial analysis for Clinical Solutions departments, including budget health, forecast accuracy, margin performance, and risk identification.
  • Lead project financial oversight across the full project lifecycle, from award through closeout, ensuring adherence to financial best practices and internal controls.
  • Perform variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) to identify drivers of change, scope creep, and emerging risks.
  • Partner with project finance teams to ensure consistency and integrity of project-level data feeding portfolio reporting.
  • Support and enhance departmental forecasting and planning processes using clear, supportable assumptions.
  • Monitor budget consumption, earned value indicators, and change order impacts across portfolios.
  • Provide forward-looking insights to support proactive financial decision-making by operational leadership.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of financial processes, controls, and reporting standards.
  • Develop and maintain trial operations KPIs and measures that link operational performance to financial outcomes (e.g., enrollment pace vs. burn, milestone progress vs. revenue, site activity vs. cost).
  • Leverage Excel and Power BI to create scalable dashboards and analyses that support portfolio governance and executive review.
  • Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights for non-finance stakeholders.
  • Act as a trusted finance partner to Clinical Solutions department heads, supporting planning, performance reviews, and strategic initiatives.
  • Prepare and deliver high-quality presentations and executive-ready materials summarizing portfolio performance, risks, and recommendations.
  • Support ad hoc analyses and special projects requested by Finance leadership, Clinical Operations leadership, or executive management.
  • Collaborate closely with Project Management, Clinical Operations, Data Management, and Finance teams to ensure alignment between operational execution and financial reporting.

Minimum Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree (or its international equivalent) + 5 years of related experience.

Preferred Education & Experience (optional)

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field (or its international equivalent).
  • Approximately 5-8 years of relevant experience in project finance, FP&A, or operational finance, with a strong preference for CRO or clinical research industry experience.
  • Demonstrated experience managing or analysing clinical trial portfolios and complex project financials.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (financial modelling, scenario analysis, large data sets).
  • Working knowledge of Power BI or similar BI/visualization tools.
  • Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leaders and department heads.
  • Solid understanding of clinical trial financial drivers, project lifecycles, and contract/budget mechanics.

Knowledge, Skills & Competencies

  • Strong financial and analytical acumen with the ability to connect operational activity to financial outcomes.
  • Executive presence and confidence interacting with senior operational leaders.
  • Ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives and recommendations.
  • High attention to detail balanced with a portfolio-level, strategic mindset.
  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

Descrição da vaga

Conhecendo um pouco mais sobre o grupo Limppano S/A.

Conhecendo um pouco mais sobre o grupo Limppano S/A. Somos um time que cuida da limpeza do seu lar gerando bem-estar, combinando determinação e comprometimento para entregar produtos de qualidade. Entendemos que para obtermos os melhores resultados, precisamos dos melhores profissionais. Estamos à procura de talentos que sejam criativos, inovadores e ousados na busca por conhecimento, que tragam resultados sustentáveis ao Grupo Limppano.

Se você tem prazer em contribuir, gosta do que faz e é focado em resultados, essa VAGA é para VOCÊ!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES:

  • Reposição de Produtos: abastecer o ponto natural da categoria (gôndolas) e pontos extras negociados ou conquistados (ilhas, terminais, pontas de gôndolas, “orelhas”, entre outros) de acordo com as diretrizes da Limppano, evitando rupturas e respeitando o FIFO (primeiro que vence é o primeiro que sai).
  • Exposição e Organização: garantir que os produtos estejam organizados e alinhados com o planograma da empresa.
  • Montagem de Pontos Extras: instalar materiais promocionais (MPDV) e montar exposições sazonais, campanhas e ações promocionais.
  • Precificação: verificar e corrigir preços nos produtos e nas gôndolas conforme as informações da loja ou da empresa. Implementar as etiquetas de preços no PDV.
  • Controle de Estoque: acompanhar o estoque na área de vendas e no depósito do PDV para evitar falta ou excesso de mercadoria.
  • Negociação de Espaços: conquistar espaços extras através de negociação com o gerente ou responsável pelo setor da loja, buscando melhor visibilidade para os produtos.
  • Coleta de Informações: realizar (via aplicativo Involves) pesquisas de preço, presença de produtos, espaço em gôndolas, implementação de MPDV, abertura de caixas, ações da concorrência, condições de exposição, entre outros, de acordo com a necessidade do momento (informações da Limppano e da concorrência).
  • Relatórios e Feedbacks: registrar evidências (fotos e informações) das execuções e enviar relatórios diários através do aplicativo Involves.
  • Relacionamento: conquistar e manter um bom relacionamento com o time de loja para facilitar as operações e execuções.
  • Sugestão de Transferências: realizar sugestão de transferência de mercadoria do Centro de Distribuição (CD) para as lojas.

Requisitos e qualificações

REQUISITOS:

  • Formação: ensino médio completo. Desejável formação técnica ou superior em andamento (Marketing, Administração, Logística, etc).
  • Experiência: vivência anterior como Promotor de Vendas no setor de limpeza será um diferencial.
  • Será um diferencial residir próximo às regiões da Tijuca, Vicente de Carvalho e Botafogo.

Condições de Trabalho:

  • Atuação externa com visitas a diferentes PDVs diariamente, seguindo a sistemática pré-determinada.
  • Trabalho físico leve a moderado (carga, movimentação e organização de produtos).
  • Eventual necessidade de deslocamento entre cidades da região.

  • Planejar a utilização de insumos conforme prescrição médica e de enfermagem;
  • Separar os materiais necessários e auxiliar os médicos ou Enfermeiros nos procedimentos realizados, tais como: punções venosas profundas, punções arteriais, intubações, entre outras, bem como providenciando o descarte dos materiais utilizado conforme protocolo;

  • Retirar todo material descartável do leito, e solicitar a limpeza terminal, em caso de alta, transferências e óbito. Em seguida, preparar o leito para possível internação;

Requisitos

  • COREN Ativo do RJ;
  • Experiência mínima de 6 meses com nefro.

Atividades

  • Proceder a montagem e instalação dos equipamentos de terapia renal substitutiva contínuas (CRRT).
  • Instalar o paciente na CRRT sob supervisão do Enfermeiro.
  • Realizar, sob supervisão do enfermeiro, a conexão e desconexão do paciente na terapia dialítica (CRRT) através dos cateteres de diálise (acesso venoso exclusivo).
  • Executar atividades rotineiras e menos complexas, como monitorização e anotação dos valores em folha de controle de diálise.
  • Monitorar os dados do equipamento e os parâmetros do paciente durante a sessão de diálise.
  • Monitorizar as pressões arterial e venosa do acesso vascular.
  • Realizar o monitoramento contínuo das terapias CRRT, avaliando a permeabilidade do dialisador, gerindo alarmes da máquina, e detectando extravasamento ou coagulação do sistema.
  • Realizar alterações na máquina conforme prescrição e orientação médica.
  • Realizar troca do sistema a cada vencimento ou em situações específicas da terapia.
  • Apoiar o enfermeiro no preparo das soluções de reposição e de dialisato, seguindo os parâmetros prescritos.
  • Realizar a troca de soluções e bolsas de coleta de efluente.
  • Acompanhar os procedimentos à beira leito, auxiliando no ajuste das linhas e cateter de diálise.
  • Prestar os primeiros atendimentos em intercorrências dialíticas, visando estabilização clínica do paciente sob orientação médica.
  • Auxiliar na administração de soluções de reposição e demais medicamentos durante o procedimento, conforme protocolo e prescrição médica.
  • Apoiar o enfermeiro nas decisões clínicas durante a sessão dialítica e em situações de emergência.
  • Acompanhar a evolução clínica de pacientes críticos sob CRRT em ambiente de UTI, conforme rotina multiprofissional.
  • Coletar e identificar, conforme indicação médica, materiais biológicos para exames durante a CRRT.
  • Identificar conforme protocolo institucional os acessos venosos, equipo de soro, kit de diálise, linhas e dialisador.
  • Executar medidas de precaução padrão e específicas (ex. contato, gotículas) conforme avaliação de risco e protocolos de biossegurança.
  • Realizar higienização rigorosa das mãos e antissepsia de superfícies e dispositivos.
  • Identificar e relatar sinais precoces de infecção ou complicações relacionadas ao acesso vascular, ou ao procedimento dialítico.
  • Promover o cumprimento das Seis Metas Internacionais de Segurança do Paciente, com foco na correta identificação, prevenção de infecções e comunicação eficaz.
  • Realizar controle rigoroso e dupla checagem de medicações de alto risco.
  • Identificar riscos no leito inerentes às condições clínicas do paciente.
  • Executar procedimentos para prevenção de lesão por pressão, quedas e complicações respiratórias.
  • Reportar à liderança situações que envolvam risco assistencial ou laboral.

title: Accreditation Client Group Coordinator
description:
Accreditation Client Group Coordinator

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Accreditation Client Group Manager, the Accreditation Client Group Coordinator supports the planning, coordination, and operational delivery of accreditation services for designated client groups for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

Working closely with Client Group Managers, Accreditation Systems, Security, Venue teams, and other functional areas, the role focuses on data accuracy, process execution, stakeholder support, and operational readiness.

The position plays a critical role in ensuring that client group accreditation applications are processed correctly, access rights are applied accurately, and services are delivered in line with FIFA accreditation policies and service standards.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Client Group Support & Coordination

  • Support accreditation delivery for assigned client groups, such as volunteers, suppliers, commercial partners, workforce, or other tournament stakeholders.
  • Assist in collecting, reviewing, and validating client group accreditation data in line with eligibility criteria and submission timelines.
  • Maintain regular communication with client group contacts to provide guidance on accreditation requirements, processes, and deadlines.
  • Coordinate closely with Client Group Managers to support overall client group readiness and service delivery.

Accreditation Process Execution

  • Support the end‑to‑end accreditation process for assigned client groups, including application tracking, data validation, approval support, badge status monitoring, and distribution preparation.
  • Assist with the accurate assignment and verification of access rights in accordance with FIFA zoning concepts, venue access matrices, and security protocols.
  • Monitor application progress and highlight issues, inconsistencies, or risks to the Client Group Manager.

Stakeholder & Functional Area Support

  • Assist in liaising with FIFA and FIFA27 functional areas to communicate accreditation guidelines and data requirements.
  • Support the preparation of guidance materials, instructions, and training documentation for client groups and venue teams.
  • Provide operational support to venue accreditation teams as required.

Event-Time Operations

  • Support the operation of Accreditation Centres and badge distribution points during test events and tournament time.
  • Assist with client service at accreditation centres, including troubleshooting data issues and supporting badge collection processes.
  • Support coordination with Security, Venue Operations, and Accreditation Operations teams to address access‑related issues promptly.
  • Escalate operational issues or irregularities to the Client Group Manager in a timely manner.

Reporting & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate records of client group accreditation statistics, issues, and resolutions.
  • Support regular reporting on volumes, progress, and operational status.
  • Assist with post‑event reporting, lessons learned, and knowledge transfer activities.

YOUR PROFILE

Education & Experience

  • University degree or equivalent experience in Event Management, Operations, Sports Administration, or a related field.
  • 1–2 years of experience in accreditation, event operations, data coordination, or client‑facing roles.
  • Experience working in major events or large‑scale operational environments is an advantage.
  • Exposure to accreditation systems or access control processes is a plus.

Skills & Competencies

  • High attention to detail and strong organisational skills.
  • Strong data handling and administrative accuracy.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in fast‑paced, time‑critical, and multicultural environments.
  • Ability to follow defined processes and elevate issues appropriately.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and online collaboration tools.

Requirements

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

description:
Turnaround Engineer

Responsibilities and assignments

We are looking for a professional to fill the Turnaround Engineer position at our office in Flamengo, Rio de Janeiro.

To perform the following tasks:

  • Support MdB’s annual corporate budget planning (expenses and investments) for the Turnaround Coordination team by providing information based on past experience, technical expertise, and industry best practices.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of the IMS by tracking and updating project statuses, monitoring implementation, and updating IMS documents under the responsibility of Turnaround Coordination.
  • Coordinate planning activities, ensuring engineering, procurement, and construction schedules are met, and ensuring project goals are achieved through detailed planning and resource management.
  • Contribute to the vessels’ POB Plan by analyzing and validating the Maintenance Service Forecast, as well as monitoring the integrated maintenance plan.
  • Lead the execution of the Operations and Organization Project, playing a proactive role in problem resolution and prevention and in identifying potential risk factors that may impact the schedule, while identifying, managing, and controlling changes.
  • Ensure technical and operational alignment by participating in technical review meetings with the client.
  • Prepare and conduct kick‑off meetings, ensuring a clear overview of the projects, adherence to the HSE strategy, information about the unit, planning facilities, previously identified risks, opportunities, and lessons learned from other projects within the unit and fleet.
  • Ensure that MODEC fleet turnaround projects are planned and executed in an optimized and integrated manner (SPIE Activities, Measurement, Design, Operations, External Clients, etc.), through the development of Master Project Schedules and Project Execution Schedules, defining the project histogram, and defining/freezing project scopes.
  • Lead the coordination of offshore activities during the execution phase by monitoring and reporting on project progress, tracking adherence to deadlines, costs, and delivery quality, and providing support to project coordinators with timely responses in the event of identified anomalies or unexpected events, in addition to providing corporate support whenever necessary.
  • Collaborate on the development of Lessons Learned, preparing, issuing, and presenting close‑out reports containing all relevant information and knowledge gained from the projects to identify opportunities for improvement for future development and knowledge sharing across the fleet, and closing all turnaround Work Orders in the CMMS.
  • Ensure the return of all equipment, tools, and materials belonging to contractors and suppliers, and properly monitor all cases.
  • Execute project Risk Assessment and Risk Management processes, conducting Risk Assessment brainstorming sessions with the necessary stakeholders, compiling and analyzing all identified risks, issuing the Risk Register, identifying potential Response Plan actions, and monitoring the progress of these actions.
  • Ensure that all systems/equipment are restored to normal performance after project completion and properly handed over to operations.
  • Establish coordination with internal and external stakeholders (other company departments, clients, suppliers, etc.) and/or external clients, preparing and conducting periodic meetings to align planning, details, and requirements of project activities and present project progress.
  • Monitor the execution phase of the planned scope on-site, participating in daily meetings with project stakeholders and PICs.
  • Plan and monitor the project preparation phase, including scaffolding setup, material segregation (onshore and offshore), submission of weekly reports to project stakeholders, and presentation of progress meetings.
  • Coordinate with the onshore and offshore teams regarding equipment mobilization for the project: shipment of contractor containers and utilities for offshore execution.

Requirements and qualifications

Requirements:

  • A bachelor’s degree in engineering is required. A master’s degree in a related field is a plus.
  • CREA certification is mandatory.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in on‑site construction supervision.
  • Offshore experience is preferred.
  • Experience with maintenance shutdowns is a plus.
  • Basic proficiency in Power BI.
  • Intermediate proficiency in Excel.
  • Advanced English.
  • Intermediate proficiency in SAP MM and PM.
  • Willingness to travel frequently.

title: DevOps Security Engineer
description:
About Legacy

Legacy is an easy-to-use, non-custodial Web3 wallet designed to protect digital assets through beneficiary protection and seamless DeFi access. Users can swap across chains, earn yield in one click, and safeguard wealth for the next generation.

About the Software Division

We are building a portfolio of software products inside the Decentralized Masters ecosystem, including:

  • Legacy Wallet - a non-custodial Web3 wallet with beneficiary protection and seamless DeFi access
  • Trading Bot - automated crypto execution tools for serious investors
  • Future fintech and investor infrastructure tools

We are now building the retention and lifecycle engine that will power long‑term recurring revenue across all products.

About The Role

You will be the single person responsible for the security of a platform that tracks hundreds of millions in digital assets. That is the job. Everything else is secondary.

We need someone who breaks things for a living. Someone who looks at a login page and sees six attack vectors. Someone who reads a pull request and catches the injection vulnerability that two senior developers missed. Someone who lies awake thinking about the phishing campaign that hasn’t been invented yet. If that sounds exhausting, this is not your role. If that sounds like Tuesday, keep reading.

Your primary responsibilities are security and quality assurance. You own penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, threat modeling, automated test frameworks, and CI quality gates across every product we ship. You also own infrastructure: AWS, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and incident response. And because we are a small, senior team, you will write production code when security and QA responsibilities are covered. You are not a consultant or a checkbox auditor. You are an engineer who ships, and whose code happens to make everything else harder to break.

The ideal candidate has spent time at major product‑driven fintech and crypto companies where a single security failure can destroy user trust overnight.

Security (Primary)

  • Own the security posture across all products: Legacy, Trading Bot, and future platforms. If something gets breached, it is your problem. If nothing gets breached, it is because of your work
  • Conduct regular penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, and threat modeling aligned with OWASP standards and methodologies
  • Ensure full coverage of the OWASP Top 10 in application security testing, code reviews, and deployment checks
  • Perform security‑focused code reviews across frontend, backend, and infrastructure code, catching what standard code reviews miss
  • Implement and manage secrets management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or KMS), access controls, and least‑privilege policies
  • Build and maintain incident response playbooks. When something breaks, you lead the response, run the post‑mortem, and ship the fix
  • Stay ahead of Web3 and crypto‑specific attack vectors: phishing campaigns, wallet exploits, API key compromises, supply chain attacks, and social engineering
  • Manage and coordinate external security audits and penetration tests from third‑party firms

Quality Assurance & Testing (Primary)

  • Design and implement test strategies across all products: unit tests, integration tests, end‑to‑end tests, API tests, and regression suites
  • Build and maintain automated testing frameworks and CI quality gates that prevent broken code from reaching production
  • Define and track quality metrics: test coverage, flakiness rate, regression detection latency, and bug escape rate
  • Write and execute security test cases: authentication flows, authorization controls, input validation, API abuse scenarios, and edge cases around financial data
  • Perform both white‑box and black‑box testing, leveraging full codebase access to catch issues that surface‑level QA would miss
  • Test across the full stack: frontend UI, backend APIs, database queries, third‑party integrations, and on‑chain interactions

Infrastructure & DevOps (Foundation)

  • Maintain and improve cloud infrastructure on AWS using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CloudFormation)
  • Own CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions preferred): automated testing, security scanning, linting, and deployment
  • Harden infrastructure: network security, IAM policies, container security, and environment isolation
  • Build logging, monitoring, and alerting across all services (CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent)
  • Ensure audit trails for user actions, system changes, and access events
  • Manage production reliability, incident response, and cost optimization

Fullstack Development (When the fortress is secure)

  • Contribute production code across frontend and backend, bringing a security‑first mindset to every feature you build
  • Build features, fix bugs, and ship improvements alongside the engineering team
  • Every line you write should make the product better and harder to break: input validation, error handling, authentication, and data protection by default
  • Participate in architecture discussions and code reviews, advocating for testability, reliability, and security in every decision

Requirements

Required

  • 5+ years in software engineering roles with meaningful, hands‑on security and QA experience. We will verify this. If your security experience is theoretical, this is not the right fit
  • Fullstack development experience: you can build and ship features across frontend (React or equivalent) and backend (Node.js, Python, Go, or equivalent)
  • Hands‑on penetration testing and vulnerability assessment experience across web applications, APIs, and cloud infrastructure
  • Strong working knowledge of OWASP standards, including the OWASP Top 10, OWASP Testing Guide, and OWASP secure coding practices
  • Experience building automated test frameworks and integrating testing into CI/CD pipelines
  • AWS expertise (EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, CloudFront, WAF)
  • Infrastructure as Code experience (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi)
  • Container technologies: Docker and Kubernetes in production environments
  • Scripting and automation proficiency in Bash and Python
  • Experience with secrets management tools (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or similar)
  • Familiarity with security and testing tools (Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Selenium, Cypress, Jest, Postman, or equivalent)
  • Strong communication skills: you can explain security risks and quality tradeoffs clearly to non‑technical stakeholders

Nice‑to‑Have

  • Security certifications: OSCP, CISSP, CompTIA Security+, AWS Security Specialty, or equivalent
  • Experience at a crypto, DeFi, Web3, or fintech product company (Coinbase, Phantom, Stripe, Casa, MetaMask, Zerion, Ramp, or similar)
  • Familiarity with Web3‑specific security concerns: wallet security, key management, on‑chain monitoring, phishing mitigation
  • SDET background or experience in a hybrid development‑and‑testing role
  • Experience testing financial systems: payment flows, ledger integrity, double‑spend prevention, or transaction monitoring
  • Experience implementing zero‑trust architectures
  • Bug bounty participation, CVE publications, or contributions to open‑source security tooling

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary + performance‑based incentives tied to retention & LTV improvement
  • Direct exposure to founders
  • Team Offsites
  • Remote work
  • High ownership, high‑impact role

title: Legal Counsel Customs and Export Controls Governance (m/f/d)
description:
OPEN TO APPLICANTS IN LATAM with experience in customs and export controls and legal background.

Fresenius Medical Care is the world’s leading provider of products and services for individuals with renal diseases of which around 3.9 million patients worldwide regularly undergo dialysis treatment. We care for more than 344,000 dialysis patients and provide our products in around 150 countries. With a strong focus on innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction, we have consistently achieved remarkable growth and established ourselves as a trusted brand in the dialysis market.

Purpose and Scope

As a Legal Counsel Customs and Export Controls Governance (m/f/d) , you will contribute to the legal backbone of Fresenius Medical Care’s global trade operations. In this role, you will provide legal guidance on customs and export control matters, support the development of compliant and cost-efficient supply chains, and help integrate trade governance into our global processes. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure adherence to international trade laws and internal policies, while driving continuous improvement and automation in trade-related legal frameworks. This is an exciting opportunity to grow within a dynamic legal environment and make a meaningful impact on global healthcare logistics.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provide legal advice, counsel and guidance and on a range of trade governance matters such as customs and export controls, free trade agreements, special customs regimes and related risk management issues.
  • Ensure that FME and affiliates operate globally in accordance with applicable trade governance laws and regulations, as well as applicable and relevant internal policies.
  • Support and advise on the development and optimization of supply chains and flows of goods to achieve cost optimization in accordance with global trade laws.
  • Support the integration and automation of trade governance processes into FME’s global operations and processes from a legal perspective.
  • Support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of Global Standard Operating Procedures (GSOPs) for customs and export controls, providing legal guidance and review in collaboration with stakeholders.
  • Continuous review of customs and export controls legislation and its applicability to FME business models and transactions.
  • Legal support and guidance in customs broker engagement and performance reviews.
  • Collaboration with stakeholders and the Customs and Export Controls Governance team for assessing training needs.
  • Support global development and customization of trainings to FME professionals involved in trade-related activities.
  • Support the coordination of global support for handling trade authorities’ audits, reviews and challenges.
  • Support in the development for automation of trade-related processes and activities.

Education

  • Fully qualified lawyer, incl. above-average university degree.

Experience and Required Skills

  • 8+ years experience in customs and export controls in an international law firm and/or in-house legal department of an internationally operating and complex corporation, specializing in customs and export control matters.
  • Preferred Master’s degree or equivalent.
  • Experience in roll-out and implementation of customs and export control policies, processes and trainings.
  • Ideally, experience in the healthcare sector.

Technical Skills

  • Good knowledge of global trade, including customs, and export control laws and regulations.
  • Knowledge of relevant commercial, tax and supply chain processes.
  • Ability to understand and apply regulatory requirements to business operations.
  • Experience with relevant trade compliance tools or willingness to learn.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, additional languages highly welcome.

Soft Skills

  • Innovation Mindset: embrace use of technology, automation and data analytics.
  • Ability to work autonomously and to remotely.
  • Ability to interpret complex customs and export control laws and regulations and apply them to real-world situations.
  • Ability to deal with ambiguity, complexity and conflicting priorities, whilst keeping a focus on main drivers.

Descrição da vaga

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

O movimento da vida gera resultados e também resíduos.

Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor e possível continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento.

Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio .

Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.

Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.

Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com apromoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

  • Liderar a originação, modelagem, estruturação e execução de investimentos em infraestrutura, concessões e PPPs, atuando em todas as etapas do ciclo de investimento;

  • Atualização do modelo financeiro com as Demonstrações Financeiras de fechamento de mês e com alterações de premissas;

title: Collections & Accounts Receivable Manager
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff ‘for fit’ makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Job Purpose

The Collections & Accounts Receivable Manager oversees university‑wide past‑due account management, directs internal and external collections efforts, and ensures compliance with federal, state, and institutional regulations. The role monitors aging, resolves complex account issues, manages payment plans, supports audits, and collaborates with campus partners to maintain accurate, student‑centered financial operations.

Supervisory Authority

Direct report – Collections Analyst

Nature And Scope

Work closely with internal and external stakeholders.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Oversee the full lifecycle of student accounts receivable, including monitoring balances, aging, past‑due accounts, and collections activity across all student populations.
  • Lead internal and external collections efforts, including coordination with third‑party collection agencies, federal loan servicers, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely and compliant recovery of outstanding balances.
  • Develop, implement, and refine collections strategies, outreach protocols, payment arrangement guidelines, and escalation pathways that align with university policy and regulatory requirements.
  • Provide high‑level review of student accounts requiring specialized consideration— including financial hardship, bankruptcy, deceased student cases, fraud concerns, and payment disputes—and recommend appropriate actions.
  • Collaborate with external vendors and internal team including Financial Aid, Registrar, Treasury, and General Accounting to address account discrepancies, apply adjustments, and resolve issues affecting student billing or aid eligibility.
  • Maintain accurate and organized documentation of collections activity, payment plans, communications, and account adjustments to support compliance, audit readiness, and institutional reporting.
  • Prepare and analyze regular collections, aging, and performance reports for leadership, identifying trends, risks, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Oversee and support the design and execution of payment plans, including eligibility review, approval workflows, and monitoring adherence to established terms.
  • Ensure compliance with FERPA, FDCPA, federal and state regulations, and institutional policies governing billing and collections activities.
  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, internal workflows, staff training materials, and quality‑control measures to promote consistency and continuous improvement.
  • Provide coaching, guidance, and support to collections staff, helping them strengthen customer‑service skills, documentation accuracy, and regulatory awareness.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex student or family inquiries, providing clear, professional, and empathetic guidance while maintaining institutional integrity and compliance.

Core Competencies

  • Accounts Receivable & Collections Management
  • Regulatory & Compliance Knowledge
  • Data Analysis & Reporting
  • Complex Problem Solving
  • Communication & Student‑Centered Service

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree required, a degree in business, finance, accounting, public administration, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 3–5 years of progressively responsible experience in student accounts, collections, accounts receivable, billing, loan servicing, or a related financial operations environment.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of federal, state, and institutional regulations related to billing and collections (e.g., FERPA, FDCPA, Title IV implications, state collection laws).
  • Experience managing, monitoring, and analyzing aging reports, receivables trends, and collections performance metrics.
  • Proven ability to resolve complex account issues involving financial aid, registration, refunds, payment plans, and account adjustments.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage professionally and empathetically with students, families, and campus partners.
  • Experience working with ERP systems (Workday preferred) and comfort using reporting tools to extract, interpret, and present financial data.
  • Strong analytical, critical‑thinking, and problem‑solving skills with high attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to develop, document, and refine workflows, standard operating procedures, outreach templates, and compliance processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with cross‑functional teams such as Financial Aid, Registrar, General Accounting, and Treasury.
  • Ability to handle confidential information responsibly and maintain the highest level of discretion.
Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide.

M3 Global Research maintains ISO 20252 and 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 Global Research, an M3 company is looking for a Senior QA Analyst to manage the daily QA activity related to work submitted by the Engineering Team.   • Develops, implements, and manages processes to ensure that products meet required specifications for quality, function, and reliability prior to delivery.

  • Comfort working alongside AI-generated code and validating its correctness through structured test strategies

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

O movimento da vida gera resultados e também resíduos.

Foi com esse propósito que nasceu aRegenera Rio .

Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.

title: Manager, Ceremonies
description:
Manager, Ceremonies

Department: Events & Entertainment Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 hosting in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

THE POSITION

The Ceremonies Manager supports the end to end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments.

Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, the Ceremonies Manager supports the planning and operational delivery of all official ceremonies, working closely with the Senior Manager and wider Entertainment team to ensure alignment with FIFA’s vision, brand standards. The role supports and coordinates the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027, ensuring that all ceremonies are executed in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA.

Working closely with the Entertainment Team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Manager supports the Senior Manager in coordinating the operational delivery of ceremonies, contributing to creative and operational review processes and helping ensure the execution of iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage.

Key Responsibilities

Ceremonies Project Leadership
  • Support the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA.
  • Support the end to end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament.
  • Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through pre production, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover.
  • Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams.
  • Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables.
  • Provide senior decision making support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation.
  • Lead the development of ceremony operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and show formats for all ceremonies, including PMC.
  • Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, Safety & Security, and other Functional Areas to integrate ceremonies seamlessly into match day and event day operations.
  • Escalate ceremony related operational matters.
  • Ensure all ceremonies reflect the approved creative vision, brand standards, cultural sensitivities, and tournament wide entertainment strategy.
Team Leadership
  • Support the Ceremonies Team by contributing to day‑to‑day coordination, operational readiness, and delivery standards.
  • Assist with the onboarding and support of Ceremonies personnel—including suppliers, freelancers, and event‑time workforce—helping ensure consistent standards and operational preparedness.
  • Contribute to internal talent development through daily guidance, structured feedback, and knowledge sharing.
  • Support effective collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units.
  • Contribute to coordination between venue‑based ceremonies teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution.
  • Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Stadium Entertainment Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonies workstreams.
Major Ceremonies Oversight
  • Support the planning and delivery processes for all major ceremonial events, including Opening, Closing, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Final Match Half‑Time Show (if applicable), and Pre‑Match Ceremonies throughout the tournament.
  • Ensure that each major ceremony reflects the ambition, brand standards, and cultural significance of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.
Creative & Concept Development / Creative Concept, Content Production & Management
  • Support the development and refinement of the ceremonial concept and creative direction for each ceremony in collaboration with the Entertainment Team.
  • Contribute to the integration of host country cultural elements into ceremonial programming in a meaningful, authentic, and respectful manner.
  • Assist in the creation of creative briefs, content commissioning, and preproduction workflows in coordination with internal teams and external agencies.
  • Contribute to stakeholder approval processes to ensure all content is delivered, documented, and archived in line with operational requirements.
  • Support IP and copyright compliance across all ceremony related content.
Planning Scheduling & Documentation
  • Maintain detailed project plans, WIP reports, and milestone trackers for all ceremony workstreams.
  • Ensure operational and creative decisions are fully documented and version controlled.
  • Coordinate with multiple suppliers, conduct regular update meetings, coordinate implementation processes, and supervise payments and reporting.
  • Prepare written and oral presentations, high‑level briefings, and reports for senior leadership and FIFA counterparts.
  • Organise and participate in Review, Project Team, and Status Update meetings.
  • Support the creation, management, and archiving of project plans, workflows, venue documentation, and readiness tools across all ceremony workstreams.
  • Contribute to ensuring readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and provide operational support on event days.
  • Support operational decision‑making to help maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies.
  • Assist with rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination for all ceremonies.
  • Support venue level pre‑production activities, including technical surveys, staging assessments, and infrastructure planning.
Supplier & Budget Management
  • Support procurement processes as directed by the Ceremonies Senior Manager, including supplier briefing and evaluation.
  • Manage day‑to‑day relationships with entertainment suppliers and contractors at assigned venue(s).
  • Assist with budget management tasks, including forecasting inputs, cost tracking, variation documentation, and invoice processing, ensuring accuracy and timely follow‑up.
  • Help monitor contractual deliverables and timelines, ensuring they remain aligned with pre‑production schedules and operational readiness requirements, and escalates risks to the Senior Manager as needed.
Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison
  • Act as a liaison between the Ceremonies Team and all relevant Functional Areas, including Venue Operations, Broadcast, Safety & Security, Marketing, and FIFA SPE, in coordination with the Senior Manager.
  • Deliver concise briefings and alignment updates across all internal and external stakeholders.
  • Support the building and maintenance of relationships with Host Country national bodies, cultural organizations, and local partners contributing to ceremonies.
  • Ensure early phase cross‑functional integration to support seamless operational delivery.
Venue Readiness & Execution
  • Support preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), ceremony production schedules, and PMC rundowns.
  • Direct venue level pre‑production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, performer logistics, and infrastructure planning.
  • Contribute to ensuring readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and support execution on the day of each event.
  • Act as the key operational decision maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies.
  • Assist in rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Ensure all creative and technical elements are validated during pre‑event testing and rehearsal phases.
Other Duties
  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by management aligned with project delivery.
  • Represent the Ceremonies function in cross‑functional planning forums and management briefings.
  • Support the Head of Entertainment in strategic planning, operational readiness, and tournament‑wide entertainment integration.

Your Profile

Education:
  • Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience.
Experience
  • 5+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large‑scale public events.
  • Prior experience in a FIFA tournament or comparable major international sports event is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, large‑scale ceremonies including opening/closing ceremonies and awards presentations.
  • Proven track record in team managership, creative development, supplier management, and cross‑functional coordination.
  • Experience managing RFP/procurement processes and overseeing multi‑supplier contracts and budgets.
  • Experience integrating cultural programming and working with national cultural bodies and creative agencies.
Skills & Competencies
  • Administrative Skills: Ability to manage office and production documentation including RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately.
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high‑pressure environments.
  • Flexibility: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period.
  • Communication Skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level.
  • Organizational Skills: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines.
  • Problem‑Solving Skills: Strategic and creative approach to problem‑solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure.
  • Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals.
  • Interpersonal Skills: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross‑functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment
  • Cultural Sensitivity: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant.
  • Passion for Entertainment: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire.
Certifications & Requirements
  • Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools.
  • Experience of Monday.com an advantage.
  • Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus
  • The right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Senior Manager, Stadium Entertainment
description:
Senior Manager, Stadium Entertainment

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

The Position

The Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager is responsible for leading the planning, development, and delivery of all Stadium Entertainment operations across the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, this role will oversee the full lifecycle of stadium entertainment activations across all tournament venues and IBCC, ensuring a consistent, high-quality and globally resonant fan experience.

This role ensures the successful implementation of the FIFA‑developed Stadium Entertainment Concept, overseeing creative, technical, and operational workstreams to deliver world‑class matchday entertainment experiences.

The position provides senior leadership, cross‑functional coordination, and operational oversight to ensure consistency, quality, and readiness.

The Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager will act as the primary point of contact for stadium entertainment matters across the tournament footprint, including the IBCC, working closely with venue teams, broadcast, and the FIFA Special Events & Entertainment (SPE) team to guarantee world‑class entertainment delivery at every match.

Key Responsibilities
  • Stadium Entertainment Project Leadership
    • Lead the operational delivery and implementation of the Stadium Entertainment Concept across all tournament venues in alignment with FIFA Entertainment (EET) in Zurich.
    • Oversee stadium‑specific pre‑production workflows including creative approvals, technical scoping, resource planning, and risk assessments.
    • Main point of contact with stadiums for LED screen specs and content delivery formats.
    • Ensure alignment of objectives, timelines, scopes, and approvals for all Stadium Entertainment activities.
    • Provide support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation for Stadium Entertainment.
    • Lead the operational planning and delivery of all stadium entertainment workstreams across all FWWC27 venues and IBCC.
    • Provide senior‑level oversight and escalation management for all Stadium Entertainment operational issues.
    • Lead the development of stadium entertainment operational plans, rundowns, and show formats for all venues.
    • Oversee implementation of the FIFA‑approved Entertainment Concept across all stadium entertainment touchpoints.
    • Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, FTI, and other Functional Areas to integrate entertainment seamlessly into match‑day operations.
    • Ensure consistency of fan experience and entertainment standards across the full tournament venue footprint.
  • IBCC Stadium Entertainment Project Leadership
    • Lead the Stadium Entertainment operation at the IBCC, overseeing all entertainment areas, operational structures, and functional setup within that environment.
    • Ensure the IBCC stadium entertainment programme is fully aligned with the broader tournament entertainment concept and operational standards.
    • Coordinate IBCC‑specific entertainment requirements with broadcast partners, venue management, and relevant Functional Areas.
    • Act as the primary point of contact for all stadium entertainment matters within the IBCC, managing suppliers and technical crews on site.
  • Team Leadership
    • Manage the Stadium Entertainment Team, providing clear direction, performance oversight, and accountability structures.
    • Mentor and support all Stadium Entertainment personnel, including full‑time staff, freelancers, and event‑time workforce, ensuring consistent standards, development pathways, and operational readiness across all staffing groups.
    • Support internal talent development through coaching and guidance.
    • Build team structures and optimise collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units.
    • Provide leadership and operational oversight to all Stadium Entertainment personnel working within the IBCC environment, ensuring clarity of roles, responsibilities, and communication flows.
    • Foster strong coordination between venue‑based teams and IBCC‑based teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution.
    • Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Ceremonies Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonial workstreams.
  • Venue Readiness & Execution
    • Lead preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), stadium production schedules, and PMC rundowns for Stadium Entertainment.
    • Oversee pre‑production processes including technical surveys, AV infrastructure assessments, and supplier installation planning.
    • Ensure readiness standards are met and oversee execution during live operations.
    • Act as the key problem‑solver to maintain seamless delivery during matchday entertainment.
    • Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination.
    • Ensure all entertainment elements are validated during pre‑event testing and rehearsal phases.
    • Direct venue‑level pre‑production processes including technical surveys, infrastructure assessments, and installation planning.
  • Content Production & Management
    • Coordinate delivery, approval, and archival of all entertainment content including music, graphics, video, and scripts.
    • Oversee creative brief development, content commissioning, and preproduction workflows with internal teams and external agencies.
    • Manage stakeholder approval pathways to ensure content is locked in accordance with operational timelines.
    • Work with the Head of Entertainment and FIFA SPE team to align creative execution with brand and communications guidelines.
    • Manage IP and copyright compliance for all entertainment content deployed at venues.
  • Planning Scheduling & Documentation
    • Oversee development of pre‑production timelines, milestone structures, and cross‑venue coordination processes for Stadium Entertainment.
    • Track and report delivery progress through detailed WIP reports and Project plan. Ensure all operational and creative decisions are documented and version‑controlled.
    • Prepare written and oral presentations, high‑level briefings and reports for Head of Entertainment, Senior leadership and FIFA counterparts.
    • Organise and participate in regular Review, Project Team, and Status Update meetings.
    • Report on project progress and stakeholder alignment to the Head of Entertainment.
    • Lead the creation, management, and archiving of project plans, workflows, venue documentation, and readiness tools across all Stadium Entertainment workstreams.
  • Supplier & Budget Management
    • Lead early‑stage budget modelling, scenario planning, and resourcing strategies to support creative and operational planning.
    • Develop and manage Scopes of Work, Procurement activities, supplier evaluations, contract negotiations, in line with FWWC27 management and procurement policies.
    • Maintain full budget oversight including forecasting, cost control, variations, and invoicing. Ensure contractual deliverables and timelines are aligned with pre‑production schedules and operational readiness requirements.
    • Conduct regular supplier update meetings and coordinate implementation processes.
  • Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison
    • Act as the senior liaison between the Entertainment Team and all relevant Functional Areas, including Venue Operations, Broadcast, Safety & Security, Marketing, and FIFA SPE.
    • Deliver concise briefings, alignment updates, and escalation management across all internal and external stakeholders.
    • Build and maintain relationships with Host Country national bodies, cultural organizations, and local partners contributing to ceremonies.
    • Ensure early‑phase cross‑functional integration to support seamless operational delivery.
  • Other Duties
    • Perform additional responsibilities as required by Senior Management aligned with project delivery.
    • Represent the Ceremonies function in cross‑functional planning forums and Senior Management briefings.
    • Support the Head of Entertainment in strategic planning, operational readiness, and tournament‑wide entertainment integration.

Your Profile

Education
  • Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience.
Experience
  • 7+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large-scale public events.
  • Prior experience in a FIFA tournament or comparable major international sports event is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, large-scale ceremonies including opening/closing ceremonies and awards presentations.
  • Proven track record in team management, creative development, supplier management, and cross‑functional coordination.
  • Significant experience managing RFP/procurement processes and overseeing multi‑supplier contracts and budgets.
  • Experience integrating cultural programming and working with national cultural bodies and creative agencies.
Skills & Competencies
  • ADMINISTRATIVE SKILLS: Ability to manage office and production documentation including RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately.
  • ADAPTABILITY: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high‑pressure environments.
  • FLEXIBILITY: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period.
  • COMMUNICATION SKILLS: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level.
  • ORGANIZATIONAL SKILLS: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines.
  • PROBLEM‑SOLVING SKILLS: Strategic and creative approach to problem‑solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure.
  • CROSS‑FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals.
  • INTERPERSONAL SKILLS: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross‑functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment.
  • CULTURAL SENSITIVITY: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant.
  • PASSION FOR ENTERTAINMENT: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire.
Certifications & Requirements
  • Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools.
  • Experience with Monday.com an advantage.
  • Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus.
  • The right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

As a next step, please visit the "Bring Stranger Soccer to your City" section — to learn more about this opportunity.

If it feels like a strong fit andyou’reinterested in exploring further, please complete the form to formally express your interest. We also encourage you to download and explore the Stranger Soccer mobile app.

Key Responsibilities

  • Launch and bring the Stranger Soccer brand to life in your assigned city
  • Build, train, and manage a small core team (2–3 people), along with freelance Official Hosts (game hosts)
  • Source and secure quality venues and time slots to host games
  • Execute creative marketing and sales initiatives (both digital and on-the-ground) to grow your player base
  • Manage game operations to ensure a consistently great customer experience that drives repeat participation
  • Leverage the support, systems, and expertise provided by our Singapore headquarters, including operations and technology

WhatWe’reLooking For

  • A strong passion for football and connection to your local football community
  • Experience in business, management, or customer-facing roles
  • An entrepreneurial mindset (prior startup or business experience is a plus)
  • Ownership mentality with the drive to build and scale a business locally
  • A results-driven attitude — earnings are directly tied to your performance, effort, and business success

About Stranger Soccer

Football is the world’s most popular sport, with over 3.5 billion fans across 200+ countries — yet many people don’t play regularly. Stranger Soccer changes that by making it as easy to play football as going for a jog or hitting the gym.

Through our mobile app, players can browse games, book instantly, and show up to play.

Born in Singapore, Stranger Soccer is now open in 10+ cities around the world, with over 100,000 games run. We continue to grow and are accepting applications from license partners who want to bring Stranger Soccer to their city. Whether you call it Fussball, Fútbol, Calcio, or anything else, the world now awaits.

Our Mission

To make playing football as easy as going for a jog.

Our Vision

A world in which playing football is as popular and widespread as watching football.

Think you have what it takes?

We’d love to hear from you.

title: Engineer - Pipe System Design
description:
Overview

Subsea Flexible Pipe System Design Engineer

Join Our Team and Shape the Future of Offshore Engineering! In NOV Subsea Production Systems (NOV SPS), part of the Fortune 500 company NOV, we power the industries that power the world. Our core business is engineering, manufacturing, and delivering high-quality flexible pipe systems for offshore oil and gas developments around the globe.

NOV SPS designs and manufactures flexible pipes and innovative subsea solutions for the offshore energy industry. With operations in Denmark (Brøndby and Kalundborg) and Brazil (Rio de Janeiro and Açu Port), we combine advanced engineering expertise with state-of-the-art manufacturing technology to deliver subsea equipment to major oil companies and installation contractors worldwide.

As demand for offshore flexible pipe systems continues to grow, we are looking for talented Pipe System Design Engineers to join our global engineering team in Brazil.

Your New Role

As part of the Pipe System Design Engineering department , you will contribute to the design and engineering of flexible pipe systems for offshore applications. Depending on your background and project needs, you may work with flexible riser system analysis or flexible pipe cross-section design , contributing to the technical development and integrity assessment of flexible pipe systems throughout project execution.

Working in a multidisciplinary environment, you will collaborate closely with other engineering disciplines, manufacturing, project management, and commercial teams to develop technically sound and cost-effective solutions for offshore field developments.

Your Responsibilities May Include

  • Designing and analyzing flexible pipe systems for offshore applications.
  • Performing structural and hydrodynamic analyses to evaluate the behavior of flexible pipes under operational, installation, and extreme environmental conditions.
  • Assessing key loading conditions including bending, tension, compression, fatigue, and environmental loads.
  • Supporting the design of flexible riser configurations (e.g., free-hanging, lazy wave) and associated components such as buoyancy modules and bend stiffeners.
  • Contributing to flexible pipe cross-section design, evaluating material compatibility, structural capacity, and potential failure modes.
  • Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across engineering, manufacturing, sales, and project management to ensure successful project execution.
  • Interfacing with clients, installation contractors, and independent verification agencies.
  • Preparing technical reports and documentation to support engineering decisions and project deliverables.
  • Ensuring compliance with industry standards such as API Spec 17J and API RP 17B.

You will be part of a global and diverse engineering organization , working on several major offshore projects simultaneously in a collaborative and international environment.

About You

At NOV, we are committed to supporting your professional development from day one. We are looking for engineers who are motivated to solve complex engineering challenges and contribute to the development of advanced offshore technologies.

To Succeed In This Role, You Typically Have

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering, Naval Architecture, Civil Engineering, Materials Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Experience in structural analysis, offshore engineering, or subsea systems (experience level may vary).
  • Familiarity with engineering tools such as Orcaflex, finite element analysis software, or similar simulation tools is an advantage.
  • Strong understanding of solid mechanics, hydrodynamics, fatigue analysis, and nonlinear structural behavior.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and international teams.
  • Good communication skills and ability to present technical information clearly.
  • Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken).

Why Join NOV SPS?

Flexible pipes are among the most complex engineered products in the offshore industry. Every system we deliver is custom designed to meet the specific operational requirements and environmental conditions of each offshore field — from Brazil to Australia, West Africa, and the North Sea.

Working at NOV SPS offers a unique opportunity to be involved in technically challenging projects that are critical to the global energy supply .

At NOV, You Will Find

  • A collaborative and international work environment
  • Opportunities to work on cutting-edge offshore engineering solutions
  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Opportunities for professional growth within a global organization
  • Exposure to both engineering design and manufacturing environments

Occasional travel may be required to support project activities or visit NOV sites and customers. You will also have opportunities to visit our Açu manufacturing facility , where you can see flexible pipe systems being produced and prepared for offshore installation.

Interested? If you are passionate about offshore engineering and eager to contribute to innovative subsea solutions, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now and become part of a company dedicated to innovation, engineering excellence, and safety.

title: Logistics Coordinator
description:
Job Summary

This role acts as the vital link between procurement and operations, ensuring that all materials are expedited, cleared through customs, and delivered to the vessel on schedule and within budget.

Key Responsibilities

Expediting & Vendor Management

  • Order Tracking: Actively monitor the status of all open purchase orders (Local and Overseas) to ensure vendor compliance with delivery dates.
  • Proactive Problem Solving: Identify potential delays in the manufacturing or shipping process and elevate to the Procurement and Technical team as needed.

International Freight & Customs Coordination

  • Freight Forwarder Management: Coordinate with global freight forwarders to book shipments via air or sea ensuring the most cost-effective and timely routes.
  • Brazil Customs Compliance: Work closely with Brazil customs brokers to ensure all documentation (Invoices, Packing Lists) is accurate to prevent costly delays at the port.
  • Consolidation: Manage the consolidation of shipments at the Brazil warehouse to optimize container space and reduce freight spend.

Operational Support & Reporting

  • SSAV Delivery: Ensure the "last mile" delivery to the vessels is coordinated with Petrobras and vessel captains.
  • Data Integrity: Maintain accurate records in the procurement system (e.g., ABS NS) regarding shipment status and delivery completion.
  • Cross-Functional Backup: Assist the wider Supply Chain team during peak periods and provide input for process improvements in the Brazil logistics flow.

Required Education & Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum 1 year experience in logistics, freight forwarding, or supply chain, preferably within the Shipping or Offshore (O&G) industry.
  • Knowledge: Good understanding of Incoterms 2020, shipping documentation, and international freight processes. Experience with Brazil customs regulations is highly advantageous.
  • Education: Certificate in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or a related field.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong communication skills to manage diverse stakeholders (Forwarders, Brokers, Suppliers).

Manager, Stadium Entertainment
