Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Stadium Entertainment Manager will be responsible for the planning, coordination and delivery of all in‑stadium entertainment activations across all assigned venues of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

Reporting to the Head of Entertainment and supporting the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager, this role ensures that all entertainment elements — including pre‑match programming, music, audio‑visual content, half‑time activations, and fan engagement moments — are delivered to the highest standard. The role supports and coordinates the implementation of the Stadium Entertainment operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, in accordance with the Stadium Entertainment Concept developed by FIFA.

Working closely with venue teams, technical suppliers, and the broader Entertainment department, the Stadium Entertainment Manager will act as the primary entertainment point of contact for their assigned venue(s), managing operational workflows, coordinating suppliers, and overseeing delivery timelines from a central coordination function. This role works in close collaboration with the on‑site venue entertainment teams, providing the planning structure, content, and operational direction required for seamless execution on match days.

The Stadium Entertainment Manager is an office‑based coordination role suited to an experienced live events professional with strong project management skills, who can drive high‑quality entertainment delivery across multiple venues through effective planning, clear communication, and proactive stakeholder management.

Key Responsibilities

Stadium Entertainment Delivery

  • Manage the day‑to‑day planning and delivery of all entertainment activations at assigned venue(s).
  • Execute the FIFA‑approved Entertainment Concept at venue level, maintaining quality and consistency throughout the tournament.
  • Coordinate all entertainment elements on match days, including pre‑match shows, half‑time activations, music programming and AV content.
  • Act as the primary on‑site entertainment point of contact for venue management, technical crews, and Functional Area partners.

Team Support

  • Support the Stadium Entertainment Team by contributing to day‑to‑day coordination, operational readiness, and delivery standards across all entertainment activities.
  • Assist with the onboarding and support of Stadium Entertainment personnel—including full‑time staff, freelancers, and event‑time workforce—helping ensure consistent standards and operational preparedness.
  • Contribute to internal talent development through daily guidance, structured feedback, and knowledge sharing within the entertainment workstream.
  • Support effective collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units involved in stadium entertainment delivery.
  • Contribute to coordination between venue‑based entertainment teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution across all stadiums.
  • Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Ceremonies Team to ensure unified delivery across entertainment and ceremonial workstreams.

Technical & Production Coordination

  • Liaise with technical suppliers including AV, LED, sound, and lighting providers to ensure correct installation and operation of all entertainment infrastructure.
  • Support pre‑event technical surveys, production walkthroughs, and infrastructure assessments at assigned venues.
  • Coordinate rehearsals and technical run‑throughs, ensuring all entertainment elements are tested and validated before match day.
  • Manage show rundowns, cue sheets, and entertainment schedules for each match at assigned venue(s).

Venue Readiness & Execution

  • Support the preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), stadium production schedules, and PMC rundowns for Stadium Entertainment.
  • Assist in preproduction processes, including coordinating technical surveys, gathering stadium LED screen specs, AV infrastructure reviews, and supplier installation planning.
  • Contribute to readiness activities and provide on‑site support during live operations to ensure delivery standards are met.
  • Support problem solving during matchday entertainment, escalating issues to the Senior Manager as needed.
  • Coordinate rehearsal planning, scheduling, documentation, and stakeholder communication in alignment with Senior Manager guidance.
  • Support the validation of entertainment elements during pre‑event testing and rehearsal phases.
  • Assist with venue‑level pre‑production tasks, including gathering technical information, supporting infrastructure assessments, and coordinating installation planning.

Content Production & Management

  • Coordinate the receipt, testing, and deployment of all entertainment content at venue level, including music, video, graphics, and scripts.
  • Ensure that all content is approved, correctly formatted, and delivered on time in line with operational deadlines.
  • Maintain accurate records of content usage and ensure IP/copyright compliance at venue level.

Planning Scheduling & Documentation

  • Prepare match‑day reports, schedules, show notes and post‑event summaries for the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date operational documentation including rundowns, contact lists, and venue entertainment plans.
  • Participate in regular team meetings, briefings, and review sessions.
  • Flag operational risks and elevate issues to the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager in a timely manner.

Supplier & Budget Management

  • Support procurement processes as directed by the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager, including supplier briefing and evaluation.
  • Manage day‑to‑day relationships with entertainment suppliers and contractors at assigned venue(s).
  • Assist with budget management tasks, including forecasting inputs, cost‑tracking, variation documentation, and invoice processing, ensuring accuracy and timely follow‑up.
  • Help monitor contractual deliverables and timelines, ensuring they remain aligned with pre‑production schedules and operational readiness requirements, and escalating risks to the Senior Manager as needed.

Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison

  • Coordinate with Venue Operations, Broadcast, Protocol, Safety, and other Functional Areas and stakeholders to integrate entertainment seamlessly into match‑day operations.
  • Support early‑phase cross‑functional integration to support seamless operational delivery.

Other Duties

  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by line management aligned with project delivery.
  • Support the Head of Entertainment and Senior Stadium Entertainment Manager in planning, operational readiness, and tournament‑wide entertainment integration.
  • Support cross‑venue entertainment activities and cover other venues as required during the tournament.

Your Profile

Education

  • Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience.

Experience

  • 5+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large‑scale public events.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering in‑venue or stadium entertainment programmes, including AV, music and audience engagement activations.
  • Experience working within large‑scale multi‑venue events or major international sporting events is highly desirable.
  • Track record of coordinating multiple suppliers and technical teams in high‑pressure, time‑critical environments.
  • Experience working with broadcast operations and an understanding of live TV production constraints is an advantage.

Skills & Competencies

  • Administrative skills: Ability to manage office and production documentation including RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately.
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high‑pressure environments.
  • Flexibility: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period.
  • Communication skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level.
  • Organizational skills: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines.
  • Problem‑solving skills: Strategic and creative approach to problem‑solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure.
  • Cross‑functional collaboration: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals.
  • Interpersonal skills: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross‑functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment.
  • Cultural sensitivity: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant.
  • Passion for entertainment: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire.

Certifications & Requirements

A ALGORIX é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada no desenvolvimento de soluções para o mercado financeiro, com forte atuação em plataformas de processamento de cartões, aplicativos mobile e sistemas transacionais de alta criticidade. Claude ou outras ferramentas de apoio.

  • Contribuir com auditorias, evidências e controles relacionados a compliance e requisitos regulatórios.

Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia em atuação de nível pleno em Segurança da Informação, Infraestrutura ou funções correlatas com interface entre as duas disciplinas.

  • Conhecimentos práticos em Windows Server e Linux/CentOS, incluindo administração, troubleshooting e sustentação operacional.
  • Conhecimento em hardening de servidores, serviços e controles básicos de segurança de infraestrutura.
  • Familiaridade com redes e protocolos, como TCP/IP, DNS, HTTPS, firewall e proteção de aplicações.
  • Capacidade de atuação investigativa, visão crítica, senso de prioridade e boa comunicação técnica.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com PCI DSS, especialmente em rotinas operacionais, auditorias, controles técnicos e proteção de dados de pagamento.
  • Conhecimento em ISO/IEC *****:****, como diferencial adicional para governança e estruturação de práticas de segurança. A ISO ***** define requisitos para um sistema de gestão de segurança da informação.
  • Certificações em segurança, infraestrutura ou compliance.

title: Associate, Finance - Payroll
description:
The FSG Finance Associate supports the payroll department’s day-to-day functions, including end-to-end payroll processing, calculating fixed and variable payments, overtime, and off-cycle payments, and ensuring compliance with complex local labor laws (CLT) and tax regulations.

What You Will Do

  • Payroll data collection and validation, such as overtime, night-shift, new hires, terminations, and vacations.
  • Maintain and update employee records in the payroll system, including hiring documentation, salary changes, personal information, and bank details.
  • Reconcile payroll data with HR records and finance systems before bank transfers.
  • Monitor leave, sick pay, maternity/paternity leave, and vacation accruals, ensuring accurate deductions and salary adjustments.
  • Ensure accurate calculation of mandatory deductions, including social/security contributions, withholding income tax, and Severance Indemnity Fund (8% employer contribution).
  • Act as the first point of contact for employee inquiries regarding pay, deductions, and tax documentation.
  • Assist with terminations, calculating severance payments, and handling new hire documentation.
  • Perform gross-to-net validations and partner with Finance to reconcile payroll funding and journal entries.
  • Assist with internal and external audits, providing payroll documentation.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities for process improvement and efficiency in your area of responsibility while minimizing risk and cost.

What You Will Need

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
  • Advanced degree.
  • One (1) or more years of experience.
  • Professional certification preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Knowledge of data privacy and security principles.
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian Labor Law (CLT) and current tax regulations.
  • Proficiency with localized Brazilian payroll/HR systems (Cloudpay, Apdata) and MS Excel.
  • Capacity to analyze, interpret, and report payroll data.
  • Accurately and efficiently input payroll data into spreadsheets or payroll system; complete high-quality data reconciliations.
  • Technically proficient with payroll systems and strong knowledge of data analysis techniques and data visualization tools and software.
  • Experience with eSocial implementation.
  • Communicate basic insights from payroll data analysis.
  • Accountability / reliability / quality / service delivery.
  • Ability to demonstrate independent, objective, open-minded thinking with strong attention to detail and sound judgment.
  • Responsibility for actions, decisions, and results while holding self and team members accountable.
  • Meet expected levels of acceptable work quality (accuracy, completeness, & timeliness).
  • Communication: listens, clarifies, responds well, speaks clearly and persuasively, writes clearly and informatively.
  • Employee development: completes assigned and mandatory training; demonstrates understanding of tasks.
  • Leadership: all levels of the organization demonstrate leadership through actions and behaviors; act as a role model; embrace change; coach and develop key skills.
  • People / teamwork: actively participate in a team; collaborate effectively; respect individuals and recognize viewpoints; understand teamwork importance.
  • Working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental Management Systems.

Reporting Relationships

Reports directly to the Payroll Supervisor.

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades

  • Recepcionar todos os clientes, profissionais e usuários
  • Anunciar os visitantes aos setores solicitados
  • Fiscalizar a entrada e saída de pessoas, veículos, prestadores de serviços
  • Monitorar as imagens de locais específicos da Instituição (via circuito interno de imagens)
  • Efetuar atendimento telefônico com direcionamento aos processos conforme necessidade
  • Fazer a comunicação imediata de ocorrência de qualquer anormalidade com relação a pessoas, ou veículos nas proximidades da portaria
  • Zelar para o desenvolvimento das atividades com atenção e objetividade
  • Desempenhar as atribuições pertinentes ao cargo sempre com atenção e respeito a todos os profissionais e visitantes
  • Efetuar diariamente controle de acionamento e desligamento da iluminação das áreas comuns da Instituição, observando os horários e/ou necessidades
  • Auxiliar, quando solicitado e autorizado, os demais colegas da portaria em suas bases administrativas
  • Controlar para que pessoas que não pertençam ao processo ou que não sejam vinculadas a qualquer atividade dos setores da SPDM/PAIS, ingressem nas dependências sem autorização dos Gestores
  • Realizar as atividades das áreas/setores, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

title: Assistant Director of Career & Professional Development - Judicial Clerkships & Fellowships
description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Assistant Director of Judicial Clerkships & Fellowships will serve as a key member of the law school’s Career Services Office, dedicated to supporting students and alumni seeking to secure judicial clerkships. The Assistant Director will provide comprehensive career counseling, develop strategic partnerships with the judiciary, and oversee programs and initiatives that enhance students\'s and graduates\' competitiveness for clerkship positions. Additionally, this role will play an integral part in identifying and assisting with specialty fellowship development pipelines.

Supervisory Accountability

Supervises student workers, temporary personnel, administrative staff, and volunteers as needed. Reports to the Dean of Career & Professional Development, Lauren Jackson.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, staff, and students in the School of Law and other University departments. External contacts include judges, organizations focused on judicial placement, serve as liaison to the Judicial Clerkship Committee, and other important contacts as deemed necessary.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Judicial Clerkship Advising: Provide individualized career counseling to students and alumni interested in judicial clerkships, including state, federal, and international positions.
  • Guide students through the application process, including resume and cover letter review, interview preparation, and navigating the OSCAR system (Online System for Clerkship Application and Review).
  • Offer specialized workshops, panels, and informational sessions on the benefits of judicial clerkships and strategies for securing them.
  • Partnership Development: Cultivate relationships with judges, court administrators, and public interest employers to create opportunities for clerkships and public sector employment.
  • Collaborate with alumni who have clerkship experience to build mentoring and networking opportunities for current students.
  • Organize and lead outreach initiatives to enhance the school’s reputation within the judiciary and public interest communities.
  • Assist with developing relationships with prominent fellowship organizations.
  • Program Management: Develop and manage programs that increase students\' and graduates\' exposure to clerkships, such as clerkship boot camps, alumni panels, and judicial internships.
  • Track and analyze data on clerkship placement and public interest employment to assess the effectiveness of programs and adapt strategies accordingly.
  • Administer funding opportunities, including stipends and fellowships, to support students pursuing unpaid clerkships.
  • Manage clerkship resources for the office such as the Vermont Clerkship Guides, NBLSA Judicial Directory, CORA, and other relevant sites.
  • Diversity and Inclusion: Advocate for and support underrepresented students in pursuing clerkships and public interest careers, ensuring they have access to resources and opportunities.
  • Develop initiatives to increase diversity within judicial clerkships, including partnerships with affinity groups and diversity organizations.
  • Collaboration and Leadership: Work closely with faculty, administration, and other career services staff to integrate clerkship advising across the curriculum.
  • Represent the law school at regional and national conferences focused on judicial clerkships and relevant public interest areas.
  • Stay informed of trends and developments in judicial clerkships to provide the most current and relevant advice to students and alumni.
  • Develop a clerkship advisory committee to assist with clerkship application review and advising.

Core Competencies

  • Experience in career services or academic advising in a law school setting.
  • Proven track record of placing students or graduates in judicial clerkships.
  • Active involvement in professional organizations related to judicial clerkships or public interest law.

Minimum Requirements

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school.
  • Experience in judicial clerkships, either through serving as a clerk or in a related advisory role.
  • Familiarity with fellowship recruiting and application process.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to build relationships with diverse stakeholders, including students, alumni, and judges.
  • Familiarity with the judicial clerkship application process, including OSCAR.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Compensation Range - $75,000 - $85,000

description:
ENGENHEIRO DE CONFIABILIDADE DE EQUIPAMENTOS ROTATIVOS / Rotating Equipment Reliability Engineer

We are seeking a professional for the Rotating Equipment Reliability Engineer position to work at our office located in Rio Corporate Office dedicated to Guyana project (MOG).

Responsibilities and Assignments

  • Technical Authority (MOC/TA & Governance)
    • Evaluate, respond to, and approve MOC/TA requests, technical changes, and deviations, ensuring compliance with MODEC standards and applicable regulations (API/ASME/ISO/ABNT).
    • Issue Technical Notes and Guidelines as a recognized subject matter expert, standardizing practices and lessons learned.
    • Ensure full documentation, traceability, and clear communication with onshore/offshore stakeholders.
  • Performance Monitoring & Improvement (Condition Monitoring)
    • Monitor rotating equipment performance using PDM/CBM techniques: vibration analysis, thermography, and oil analysis (including ferrography and spectroscopy) for early anomaly detection.
    • Oversee and perform Product/Performance Data Monitoring (PDM) services, recommending corrective and preventive actions.
    • Develop and implement condition‑based maintenance (CBM) programs to optimize availability and reduce downtime.
  • Reliability Engineering (RCM/Strategy/MTBF)
    • Develop and implement reliability and maintenance strategies (RCM), with preventive/predictive plans to improve MTBF and lifecycle cost.
    • Perform diagnostics on pumps, centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, gearboxes, and Dry Gas Seal systems; recommend corrective actions.
    • Identify and manage “bad actors,” drive elimination plans, and prioritize investments to sustain reliability improvements.
  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
    • Lead RCA for failures and recurring issues using structured methodologies (5 Whys, Ishikawa, TapRooT, etc.); issue actionable reports and verify effectiveness of actions.
    • Conduct component failure analyses (seals, bearings, rotors, gears, shafts) and propose design, operational, or maintenance improvements.
  • Troubleshooting & Technical Support
    • Provide day‑to‑day technical support to Operations and Maintenance to resolve machinery issues, unplanned shutdowns, and control/operating parameter optimizations.
    • Offer guidance for commissioning/start‑up, operations, overhauls, and controls/monitoring upgrades for rotating equipment.
  • Asset Lifecycle & Projects (Design Review & Installations)
    • Support capital projects by reviewing specifications for maintainability and reliability and ensuring correct installation/alignment per API/AGMA/ISO.
    • Support preparation of Technical Risk Assessments (TRA) and contribute to continuous improvement of processes and systems.

Requirements and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering. MBA/Postgraduate in Reliability, Maintenance, or Asset Management is a plus.
  • Experience in rotating equipment operations, maintenance, or reliability in Oil & Gas (offshore/onshore), focusing on centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, pumps, and turbomachinery.
  • Strong knowledge of rotating equipment reliability, RCM, CBM, and PDM services.
  • Hands‑on experience in condition monitoring (vibration, oil analysis, thermography) and failure diagnostics.
  • Demonstrated troubleshooting and field condition monitoring experience.
  • Solid knowledge of API standards (e.g., 610/617/618/670/682/686), machinery design, lubrication, mechanical seals (incl. Dry Gas Seals), rotor dynamics, balancing, alignment, and modal analysis.
  • Working knowledge of international codes and standards (ASME, ANSI, ISO 10816/20816);
  • Deep understanding of rotating equipment: pumps, compressors, Dry Gas Seal systems, and gearboxes.
  • Vibration analysis certification (e.g., ISO CAT II/III) desired; oil analysis/thermography certifications are advantageous.

Systems & Software

  • Proficiency with CMMS (SAP preferred) and machinery/condition monitoring software.
  • OSIsoft PI System and System 1 knowledge is differential. Advanced Microsoft Office: Power BI is a plus.
  • Advanced English.
  • Active CREA (as applicable for Brazil).

Fan Services Manager

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027. That will be hosted in South America in Brazil for the first time ever. This is an opportunity to be part of the workforce that is creating an unique and unforgettable experience.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Head of Venue Operations, the Fan Services Manager is responsible for delivering a world-class fan experience at the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027. This role leads the planning, coordination, and delivery of fan services across all venues, ensuring that spectators enjoy a safe, welcoming, and seamless experience from arrival to departure.

The Fan Services Manager acts as the primary point of contact for all key fan service deliverables within stadium operations, ensuring consistency and compliance with agreed service standards across the tournament.

This role requires effective management of spectator services, close coordination with FIFA Functional Areas, and strong engagement with internal and external stakeholders. Key focus areas include clear communication, problem‑solving, innovation, issue escalation, transparency, and the use of reporting tools to ensure operational excellence.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of Fan Services operations across all venues.
  • Ensure high-quality fan experiences aligned with FIFA service standards and spectator expectations.
  • Work closely with stadium Spectator Service, Guest Experience, Operations, Security, and other teams to integrate tournament operations with existing services, including the development and execution of efficient Spectator Service and Crowd Management plans.
  • Coordinate with FIFA Functional Areas, stadiums, and external stakeholders on Last Mile operations to ensure safe, efficient access to and from venues.
  • Develop and manage the Fan Services project plan, ensuring alignment with the overall FWWC2027 programme.
  • Oversee fan service spaces, assets, Furniture, Fixtures & Equipment (FF&E), and related logistics across venues.
  • Manage staff and volunteer requirements for Fan Services central and in each stadium.
  • Support procurement processes by defining operational and technical requirements for fan services at each stadium.
  • Contribute to budget planning, track delivery, and support post‑event reporting and debriefing.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks related to fan services across all venues.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • University degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education).
  • Bilingual - Brazilian Portuguese and English.
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years delivering Fan Services at international sporting events.
  • Proven experience managing fan services for complex, multi‑venue events involving multiple stakeholders and authorities.
  • Strong knowledge of crowd management particularly within sporting events.
  • Solid understanding of event planning and project management methodologies.
  • Demonstrated excellence in customer service delivery.
  • Strong presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and lead cross‑functional teams without formal reporting lines.
  • Experience in budgeting, financial oversight, and resource management for large‑scale events.
  • Strong crisis‑management capability with the ability to remain calm and decisive under pressure.
  • Familiarity with host stadium operations is considered an asset.
  • Flexibility and adaptability in dynamic and evolving environments.
  • Strong IT proficiency, including MS Office and Visio.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong team player with ability to meet tight deadlines.
  • Solution‑oriented mindset with resilience and positivity under pressure.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage high workloads during peak periods.
  • Sound judgment and critical problem‑solving skills.
  • Effective leadership, motivational, and negotiation skills.
  • High energy, adaptability, and entrepreneurial spirit.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Cultural awareness and sensitivity, with experience in international contexts.

Requirement

  • The right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

description:
The RRS Group

The RRS Group, and its affiliated entities (collectively, “RRS”) have provided real estate development and related services to investment-grade clients for decades. Our expertise encompasses site acquisition, architectural design, and development management for commercial office and industrial properties.

Through an integrated service model, RRS delivers comprehensive enterprise solutions that address every phase of the building lifecycle. In addition to technical excellence, we offer strategic consulting in marketing, financial planning, and facility management ensuring that every project achieves its highest potential in performance, value and sustainability.

Commitment to Community

For over two decades, RRS has maintained a strong commitment to the communities we serve. This commitment is further advanced through the RRS Making Lives Better Foundation, which provides meaningful support and resources to individuals and families in need. The Foundation reflects our belief that corporate success carries a responsibility to contribute positively to society and to improve the quality of life in the regions where we operate.

Our Core Values

Integrity | doing the right thing when no one is watching and acting with uncompromising honesty. We believe in maintaining lasting relationships based on honesty, consistency and the highest ethical standards. This creates credibility in our personal and professional relationships.

Caring | showing concern, empathy and compassion for others, ourselves and our environment. Our care shows itself in our commitment to “safety first” in all we do. We encourage each other to be the best and hold each other accountable. We help those in need, contribute to the communities in which we work and develop creative ways to be responsible with our resources.

Integration | working unselfishly toward common goals across disciplines, teams, departments and regions. Our collective contributions are greater than our skills. We will be transparent and understand each other’s expertise to provide the most value when delivering our services to one another and our clients.

Innovation | developing new ideas and applying the solutions that differentiate us in valuable ways. We are not comfortable with the status quo. We remain accountable for continuous improvements in our results because we do not consider innovation an end in itself. We maintain an environment where we foster new ideas and encourage changes that help us improve.

Full Stack AI Engineer

We’re seeking a Full Stack AI Engineer who can design, build, and ship AI‑powered products end‑to‑end from data layer to user interface. This role is for a builder who thrives at the intersection of modern app engineering and applied AI, and who wants to create products that directly improve how real estate assets are managed, leased and optimized across a multi‑billion dollar global portfolio.

What You’ll Do

Build AI‑Powered Products End‑to‑End

  • Build and integrate AI/ML capabilities into production applications — including LLM‑powered workflows, MCP tool integrations, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG) and predictive analytics.
  • Own features from concept through deployment: frontend UI, API design, backend services, data pipelines and AI model integration.
  • Rapidly prototype and iterate on AI‑driven features, moving from proof of concept to production with speed and quality.

Engineer for Scale and Performance

  • Build responsive, accessible frontend interfaces using modern frameworks (React/Next.js or similar).
  • Design and implement scalable backend services and APIs (Python, Node.js, or similar) that serve both human users and AI agents.
  • Work with cloud infrastructure (Azure preferred) including serverless functions, container orchestration and managed AI/ML services.
  • Ensure production systems are reliable, observable and secure — with appropriate monitoring, logging and error handling.

Collaborate and Ship

  • Partner with Product Management, Design, Business owners and Data Engineering to define and deliver high‑impact features.
  • Participate in architectural decisions that affect the broader platform, advocating for simplicity, maintainability and AI‑readiness.
  • Collaborate with other engineers on AI integration patterns, prompt engineering and modern development practices. We are an AI‑forward team and it’s moving fast so we test, iterate, share and repeat.

Qualifications

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience shipping production applications.
  • Strong proficiency in both frontend (React, TypeScript, modern CSS) and backend (Python, Node.js, or Go) development.
  • Deep experience with AI coding tools like Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, etc.
  • Experience designing and building RESTful APIs, microservices and event‑driven architectures.
  • Solid understanding of relational and non‑relational databases, caching strategies and data modeling.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code and cloud platforms (Azure preferred, AWS/GCP acceptable).

AI/ML Integration

  • Hands‑on experience integrating LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic or similar) into production applications — including prompt engineering, function calling and agent workflows.
  • Familiarity with RAG architectures, vector databases, embedding models, and MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar tool‑use patterns.
  • Understanding of when to build vs. buy AI capabilities and how to evaluate AI vendor tools critically.
  • Personal projects or portfolio demonstrating AI‑powered applications you’ve built — we want to see what you’ve shipped.

Domain Knowledge (Preferred)

  • Experience in real estate, property management or asset management is a strong plus.
  • Familiarity with marketplace or multi‑sided platform products.
  • Experience working in data‑intensive environments where data quality and governance matter.

Mindset & Communication

  • AI‑first mindset — you naturally look for opportunities to automate, augment and accelerate with AI in your daily work and product development.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to explain technical trade‑offs to non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward shipping iteratively over waiting for perfection.
  • Collaborative approach; you work well across product, design, data and business teams.

What can you expect from us

  • Opportunities to learn and develop every day through a wide range of programs.
  • Internal digital platforms that promote self‑learning.
  • Development programs according to leadership skills.
  • Specialized training according to the role.
  • Learning experiences with internal and external providers.
  • Recognition programs for seniority, behavior, leadership, moments of life and more.
  • Financial wellness programs that will help you reach your goals in all stages of life.
  • A flexibility program that will allow you to balance your personal and work life, adapting your working day to your lifestyle.
  • Family‑related benefits such as our WellnessLine, thousands of agreements and discounts, scholarship programs for your children, aid plans for different moments of life and more.

Work Hours

Varies upon the needs of the global department.

title: OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect
description:
The OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect is responsible for designing and implementing the technical components of the organization's cybersecurity strategy. This role involves creating secure systems and network architectures, selecting and configuring security technologies, and collaborating with cross‑functional teams to ensure the organization's digital assets are adequately protected.

  • Develop and implement OT cybersecurity architectures tailored for renewable energy production and operations.
  • Design secure and scalable network architectures for OT environments, including SCADA, ICS, and IoT systems.
  • Ensure OT security strategies align seamlessly with corporate IT and cybersecurity policies, while also adhering to industry standards, including IEC 62443 and ISO 27001.
  • Implement and supervise cybersecurity tools, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and vulnerability scanners, in OT environments.
  • Monitor and respond to OT security incidents, collaborating with incident response teams.
  • Collaborate with GRC team to address regulatory requirements.
  • Work closely with engineering, operations, and IT teams to integrate security into the lifecycle of OT assets.
  • Provide cybersecurity training and awareness programs for staff working with OT systems.
  • Engage with external vendors and partners to ensure secure deployment of third‑party OT solutions.
  • Stay updated on emerging cybersecurity threats, trends, and technologies relevant to OT environments.
  • Develop and implement strategies for continuous improvement of OT cybersecurity posture.
  • Lead pilot projects and proof‑of‑concept initiatives for new cybersecurity technologies.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCES

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, with at least 2 years focusing on OT environments (e.g., SCADA, ICS).
  • Deep knowledge of OT systems and protocols, including Modbus, DNP3, OPC, and MQTT.
  • Proficiency with cybersecurity frameworks like IEC 62443, NIST CSF, and MITRE ATT&CK for ICS.
  • Familiarity with firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and endpoint protection in OT environments.
  • Strong understanding of networking principles (e.g., VLANs, VPNs, routing).
  • Experience in renewable energy or other critical infrastructure industries is a plus.
  • CISSP, GICSP, CISM, or equivalent certifications preferred.
  • Proficiency both in Portuguese and English.
  • Availability for international travels.

KEY SKILLS

  • Strategic vision
  • Problem‑solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong ability to articulate technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Proficiency in building relationships with internal and external partners to drive cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Resilient
  • Strong attention to detail to ensure precision in designing, implementing, and auditing cybersecurity measures.
  • Flexibility to respond to evolving cybersecurity threats and technological advancements.

title: Senior Manager, Ceremonies
description:
Senior Manager, Ceremonies

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC27”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

THE POSITION

The Ceremonies Senior Manager leads the end‑to‑end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre‑Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half‑Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments.

Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, this role is responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of each ceremony—from planning and preparation through to live execution—ensuring full alignment with FIFA’s vision and brand standards. The role also manages the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA.

Working closely with the Entertainment team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Senior Manager acts as the senior operational lead for all ceremony delivery, ensuring creative and operational approvals are met and delivering iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Ceremonies Project Leadership

  • Lead the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA.
  • Manage the end-to-end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament.
  • Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through preproduction, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover.
  • Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams.
  • Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables.
  • Provide senior decision-making support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation.
  • Lead the development of ceremony operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and show formats for all ceremonies, including PMC.
  • Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, Safety & Security, and other Functional Areas to integrate ceremonies seamlessly into matchday and event day operations.
  • Act as the senior escalation authority for all ceremony related operational matters.
  • Ensure all ceremonies reflect the approved creative vision, brand standards, cultural sensitivities, and tournament wide entertainment strategy.

Team Leadership

  • Manage and mentor the Ceremonies Team, providing clear direction, performance oversight, and accountability structures.
  • Mentor and support all Ceremonies personnel, including fulltime staff, freelancers, and event time workforce, ensuring consistent standards, development pathways, and operational readiness.
  • Support internal talent development through coaching, guidance, and structured feedback.
  • Build team structures and optimize collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units.
  • Foster strong coordination between venue based ceremonies teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution.
  • Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Stadium Entertainment Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonial workstreams.

Major Ceremonies Oversight

  • Manage planning and delivery management for all major ceremonial events, including: Opening Ceremony, Closing Ceremony, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Final Match Half-Time Show (if applicable), Pre-Match Ceremonies throughout the tournament
  • Ensure that each major ceremony reflects the ambition, brand standards, and cultural significance of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

Creative & Concept Development / Creative Concept, Content Production & Management

  • Collaborate with the Entertainment team to develop and refine the ceremonial concept and creative direction for each ceremony.
  • Integrate host country cultural elements into ceremonial programming in a meaningful, authentic, and respectful way.
  • Oversee creative brief development, content commissioning, and pre-production workflows with internal teams and external agencies.
  • Ensure all creative content — including music, graphics, videos, scripts, translations, choreography and performances — is approved and locked in line with operational timelines.
  • Manage stakeholder approval pathways to ensure content is delivered and archived in accordance with operational requirements.
  • Manage IP and copyright compliance for all ceremony content.

Planning Scheduling & Documentation

  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, WIP reports, and milestone trackers for all ceremony workstreams.

A Leve Saúde é uma operadora de saúde carioca que nasceu com opropósito de transformar a forma como o cuidado em saúde é oferecido no Brasil . Acreditamos que cuidar vai muito além de oferecer planos — é construir relações, escutar de verdade e estar presente na jornada de cada pessoa.

Desde o início, apostamos em um modelo mais próximo, acolhedor e resolutivo. Com equipes próprias e rede integrada, promovemos uma experiência de saúde mais leve, eficiente e centrada no paciente.

O que nos move:

  • Tornar o cuidado em saúde mais humano e acessível.
  • Reduzir burocracias e facilitar o acesso a serviços de qualidade.
  • Usar a tecnologia como aliada para melhorar a experiência e os resultados em saúde.

Como fazemos isso:

  • Com clínicas próprias, prontas para atender com acolhimento e eficiência.
  • Com uma equipe multidisciplinar que acompanha de perto a jornada dos beneficiários.
  • Com um time interno comprometido com inovação, qualidade e propósito.

Somos uma empresa em constante crescimento, e cada colaborador é parte essencial dessa construção. Aqui dentro, acreditamos em colaboração, em diálogo e no poder de fazer diferente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Receber os pacientes com empatia, cordialidade e atenção desde a chegada à clínica;

Realizar o acolhimento inicial, identificando necessidades e oferecendo suporte personalizado;

Orientar sobre procedimentos, horários, documentos e fluxo da clínica;

Esclarecer dúvidas sobre consultas, exames, encaminhamentos e demais serviços;

Realizar autorização de guias junto a operadoras de saúde (via sistemas como TISS ou plataformas específicas);

Efetuar o recebimento de atendimentos particulares, incluindo emissão de recibos e controle de pagamentos;

Acompanhar o paciente durante sua jornada, garantindo conforto e tranquilidade;

Após a consulta, verificar como foi a experiência e oferecer suporte adicional, se necessário;

Atuar como ponte entre paciente e equipe médica/administrativa, promovendo comunicação clara;

Receber e organizar documentos, correspondências e resultados de exames;

Auxiliar em tarefas administrativas como preenchimento de fichas, arquivamento e atualização de cadastros;

Manter a recepção limpa, organizada e funcional.

Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino médio completo (superior em áreas da saúde, humanas ou hospitalidade é um diferencial);

Excelente comunicação verbal e escuta ativa;

title: Mecânico Diesel
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua nos segmentos automotivo e do agronegócio, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac(AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkotruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Sua missão:

  • Elaborar planos e executar manutenções.
  • Substituir peças, reparar e testar desempenho de componentes e sistema de veículos.
  • Efetuar diagnósticos e reparos em conjuntos mecânicos, pneumáticos, hidráulicos e elétricos.
  • Realizar serviços de lubrificação dos veículos.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Médio Completo.
  • Experiência na função.
  • Informática Básica.
  • Atuação em concessionária e formação em técnica em Mecânica Diesel, Mecatrônica e afins, será um diferencial.

Vantagens/Benefícios:

  • Ticket Alimentação-pensado para garantir praticidade no cuidado com a sua casa e família.
  • Assistência Médica-cuidando da sua saúde e de quem você ama.
  • Assistência Odontológica-cuidando do seu sorriso e de toda a sua família.
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo e Assistência Funeral-proteção e segurança para você e sua família em momentos delicados.
  • Wellhub(Gympass)-incentivo à prática de atividades físicas e ao bem-estar.
  • Telemedicina: Dra.AON| Conexa Saúde-apoio à sua saúde com praticidade e rapidez, sempre que precisar.
  • Premiação anual– reconhecimento pelo seu desempenho.
  • Programa de Desenvolvimento Educacional(PDE)-apoio financeiro einstitucionalpara formações, cursos ou especializações alinhadas às suas atividades e ao desenvolvimento da empresa.
  • Comissionamento- variável conforme a performance eprodutividade.

Para sua comodidade a empresa também oferece Vale Transporte e Uniforme.

description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with deep expertise in software development who can design and evolve modern architectures, lead engineers through best practices, and collaborate directly with client stakeholders on solution design and technical decisions. You will set engineering standards for the team, perform code reviews, coach developers, and ensure we deliver secure, reliable, and scalable software.

How You'll Make An Impact

  • Define and evolve application architectures (monoliths, microservices, event‑driven), ensuring clear domain boundaries, integration patterns, and API contracts.
  • Lead architectural reviews and technical decision‑making, balancing trade‑offs across scalability, performance, security, and cost.
  • Ensure non‑functional requirements (reliability, observability, security, and performance) are embedded throughout design and delivery.
  • Drive the development of high‑quality .NET services and APIs, setting technical direction for standards, versioning, and documentation.
  • Establish and enforce engineering best practices through code reviews, CI/CD alignment, clean and secure coding standards.
  • Act as a technical leader, mentoring the team, fostering continuous learning, and enabling scalable, observable solutions.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in computer engineering, computer science, or a related field.
  • Strong experience in software development and AI experience.
  • Solid architectural knowledge (DDD, CQRS, monolith vs. microservices, event‑driven systems).
  • Proven technical leadership, including code reviews, branching strategies, and guidance on best practices.
  • Deep knowledge of the .NET ecosystem (C#, ASP.NET Core, API design, async programming, relational databases).
  • Experience with cloud environments, containers, and CI/CD pipelines (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
  • Solid understanding of observability and security fundamentals.
  • Experience collaborating with front‑end teams and applying modern testing practices.
  • Ability to discuss solutions with client architects, negotiate trade‑offs, and justify decisions.
  • Advanced English proficiency.

About the Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.

The specific and existing team takes care of the sales of industrial steam turbines in Latin America in different industries up to a size of 250 MWe.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met optimally and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150‑year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

  • Flexible work environment with flex hours, telecommuting and digital workspaces

title: Pricing & Payments Manager, Partner Strategy & Experience
description:
Description

Amazon is the most customer-centric company on Earth. We need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people who are passionate about doing the right thing.

We are looking for a Pricing & Payments Manager to lead the Pricing, Incentives, Payments & Disputes function within Amazon's Last Mile Brazil organization. This role owns the end-to-end strategy and execution of partner pricing models, incentive programs, payment accuracy, and dispute resolution across our Amazon Partner Logistics programs — EDSP (External Delivery Service Provider), AMPL (Amazon Partner Logistics), and AMXL (Amazon Extra Large).

As a People Manager, you will lead and develop a team of specialists, set the strategic direction for pricing and payment mechanisms, build scalable processes, and drive cross-functional alignment with Finance, Operations, and Procurement to ensure partner economics are competitive, accurate, and sustainable.

This position is based out of an Amazon corporate office and may require periodic travel.

If you are passionate about partner economics, operational excellence, and building high-performing teams, you should join our team.

Key job responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Pricing, Incentives, Payments & Disputes specialists, fostering a culture of ownership, analytical rigor, and continuous improvement
  • Own the end-to-end pricing strategy for logistics partners across EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL programs, ensuring competitive and sustainable rate structures
  • Design, implement, and optimize incentive programs that drive partner performance, network efficiency, and cost effectiveness
  • Oversee the payment lifecycle — from invoice validation and payment accuracy to dispute identification, root cause analysis, and resolution
  • Build and maintain scalable mechanisms for pricing governance, incentive tracking, payment reconciliation, and dispute management
  • Develop structured reporting and dashboards to monitor pricing competitiveness, incentive ROI, payment accuracy, and dispute aging/resolution rates
  • Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Operations, Procurement, and Legal to align pricing models with business objectives and contractual frameworks
  • Identify and drive automation opportunities to reduce manual intervention in payment and dispute processes
  • Conduct periodic pricing benchmarking and market analysis to ensure Amazon's partner economics remain competitive
  • Manage escalations related to partner payments and disputes, ensuring timely resolution and stakeholder alignment
  • Define and track KPIs for the team, establishing clear goals, performance standards, and development plans for direct reports

A day in the life

Your day starts with metrics review and team's priorities. Your focus centers on strategic decisions that shape partner economics across EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL. You lead cross-functional negotiations with Finance, Operations, and Procurement to align pricing models with business objectives. You assess incentive program ROI, recommending adjustments to optimize cost efficiency and partner performance. You review payment accuracy dashboards, identifying systemic gaps and designing scalable mechanisms to address them. Between meetings, you coach your team on stakeholder influence and data-driven storytelling. Every day balances strategic thinking, cross-functional alignment, and talent development to drive sustainable partner economics at scale.

About The Team

The Pricing & Payments team is part of Amazon Logistics' Partner Strategy & Experience organization, supporting the EDSP (External Delivery Service Provider), AMXL (Amazon Extra Large), and AMPL (Amazon Partner Logistics) programs across Brazil — a network of +30 logistics partners and +300 operational nodes. Our mission is to ensure Amazon's logistics partners operate under competitive, transparent, and accurate pricing and payment frameworks, while driving performance through well-designed incentive programs and efficient dispute resolution. We build scalable pricing models, payment governance mechanisms, and incentive strategies that balance cost efficiency with partner sustainability. The team sits within a broader strategic structure that also covers Compliance & Communications, Network Health & Performance, and VAS & DA Experience — working cross-functionally to support Amazon's Last Mile growth in Brazil.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in business, operations, logistics, supply chain or engineering
  • Speak, write, and read fluently in English
  • Experience managing and developing high performance teams
  • Experience conducting sophisticated and creative analysis of complex data and translate the results into actionable deliverables, messages, and presentations
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams across business development, marketing, operations, product development, legal, etc.
  • Experience implementing scalable compliance solutions (technology, procedures, processes, etc.) in a regulated environment
  • Experience in communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal in Portuguese & English
  • Experience in deal management and pricing strategy, or financial consulting

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA, or Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field
  • Experience using any of SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis
  • Experience with Lean or Six Sigma analytical techniques
  • Experience in logistics
  • Knowledge of Six Sigma, Lean manufacturing efforts, transportation and logistics, or fulfillment and distribution centers
  • Experience in financial modeling, P&L management or analysis, or experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field
  • Experience designing incentive programs or performance-based compensation structures
  • Experience building payment reconciliation or dispute management mechanisms at scale

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:
Would you thrive in a role where technical communication, knowledge structuring and collaboration are essential to enabling engineering excellence?

Would you enjoy transforming complex technical information into accessible, clear and high‑quality documentation that supports teams across a global organization?

Join our Knowledge Management Team!

At Baker Hughes, Knowledge Management (KM) is essential for accelerating learning, promoting collaboration, and ensuring that expertise is captured and shared across the organization. Our KM team drives digital collaboration tools, documentation excellence, and user‑centric solutions that support engineering, technology and business functions.

Partner with the best!

As a Knowledge Management Technical Author, you will collaborate with engineers, subject matter experts and business stakeholders to develop high‑quality technical documentation and maintain digital KM platforms—primarily based on SharePoint. You will help shape a business‑wide system that enables collaboration, governance and efficiency across Flexible Pipe Systems (FPS) and other OFSE teams.

As a Knowledge Management Technical Author, you will be responsible for:

Technical Writing & Content Development

  • Researching and gathering knowledge from engineers and technical specialists to understand complex products, processes and systems.
  • Producing clear, concise and technically accurate documentation including manuals, guides, communication materials, instructions and support resources.
  • Applying translation responsibilities (English Portuguese) across the department.
  • Reviewing, editing and simplifying existing documents to ensure accuracy, consistency and clarity.
  • Creating diagrams, illustrations, screenshots and other visuals to support engineering explanations.

Knowledge Management & Content Governance

  • Updating and maintaining libraries of technical information within CMS platforms and KM repositories.
  • Ensuring documentation aligned with Baker Hughes standards remains up‑to‑date, correct and consistent.
  • Supporting implementation of KM methodologies, continuous improvement and Lean practices.
  • Identifying and eliminating roadblocks to knowledge sharing while promoting best practices.

SharePoint & Digital Collaboration

  • Creating, managing and updating SharePoint content, pages, templates and tools used across FPS.
  • Supporting system efficiency through communication, training and stakeholder engagement.
  • Coordinating upgrades, improvements and fixes within the KM environment.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Consulting

  • Meeting with teams to develop documentation, templates and SharePoint content aligned with business needs.
  • Reviewing new materials with users and experts to ensure relevance and quality.
  • Partnering closely with FPS Chief Engineers’ Office and global KM teams.
  • Advising on document formatting, intellectual property, branding, confidentiality classifications and export control requirements.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role, you will:

  • Have a Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
  • Have fluency in English and Portuguese (written and spoken).
  • Have proven experience as a Technical Writer, Technical Author or similar documentation‑focused role.
  • Familiarity with Knowledge Management principles and methodologies.
  • Have proficiency in MS Office and adaptability to digital tools used for documentation and collaboration.
  • Have experience with SharePoint (coding knowledge is beneficial but not required).
  • Have previous experience in the Oil & Gas industry or an equivalent technical sector.
  • Have excellent written communication skills with strong attention to detail and clarity.
  • Have the ability to learn complex technical topics and participate in technical discussions.
  • Have the ability to work independently and collaboratively with global, cross‑functional teams.
  • Have strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Have familiarity with Simplified Technical English (STE).
  • Have an understanding of the Engineering Lifecycle.
  • Willingness to travel internationally if required (desirable).
  • Experience developing Power Apps, Power BI dashboards or Power Automate flows (desirable).

Work in a way that works for you

In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • Working from 7am-4pm or 8am-5pm.
  • Location: RETIC, Ilha do Fundão, Rio de Janeiro.

Working for you

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
  • Comprehensive private medical care options
  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
  • Tailored financial programs
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Sustainability Experienced Professional - Knowledge Management

title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
Job Overview

In this role, you will be responsible for creating clear, structured, and highly technical documentation for internal engineering systems, partnering closely with senior developers and infrastructure teams. You’ll apply a strong foundation in software engineering along with hands‑on knowledge of cloud and DevOps environments— including Azure GovCloud, infrastructure provisioning with Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, PostgreSQL operations and disaster recovery, configuration management, and observability best practices. You’ll produce concise how‑to guides, installation and troubleshooting procedures (PowerShell/Bash), and standardized content organized for developer audiences using defined templates. Success in this role requires proficiency with Confluence, GitHub, Jira, and diagramming tools, plus excellent information architecture skills. You’ll also independently manage limited SME availability through effective interviewing and scheduling, while communicating directly with Directors and Lead Engineers to deliver accurate, user‑friendly documentation.

Required Skills and Expertise

Software Engineering Foundation

  • A deep understanding of software development and engineering principles is a primary requirement.
  • Cloud & DevOps Literacy: The writer must be comfortable documenting highly technical, internal‑facing systems.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Azure (GovCloud/IL4), cloud architecture, Infrastructure as a Service, Terraform, and provisioning.
  • CI/CD: Complex continuous integration and deployment pipelines.
  • Databases: PostgreSQL provisioning, operations, and disaster recovery (DR).

Configuration Management

  • Documenting unified configuration systems and migration from legacy tools.
  • Observability: Writing best practices for monitoring and alerting.

Core Documentation & Writing Skills

  • Clarity and Conciseness: The ability to create clear, concise, and user‑friendly documentation.
  • Procedural Writing: The writer must be able to create clear how‑to guides, particularly for installation (using PowerShell/Bash) and troubleshooting.
  • Information Architecture: The project requires standardizing formats and organizing content logically for a developer audience (e.g., "Onboarding," "Infrastructure," "Troubleshooting") to improve findability.
  • Template Adherence: The writer must be able to follow specific templates, such as the MSF Docs Single Page Design, which outlines a precise structure for content.

Tool Proficiency

  • Content Platforms: Confluence and GitHub as the primary documentation platforms.
  • Collaboration Tools: Familiarity with Jira for project tracking and Lucidchart (or similar) for diagrams if necessary.

Soft Skills

  • SME Management: Managing the limited availability of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) is a primary risk.
  • Strong interviewing skills and the ability to work independently to proactively schedule and manage SME time.

Stakeholder Communication

The role requires collaborating directly with senior engineering stakeholders, including Directors and Lead Software Engineers.

Benefits

  • Flexible working format—remote, office‑based or flexible
  • Competitive salary and compensation package
  • Personalized career growth
  • Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
  • Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
  • Education reimbursement
  • Memorable anniversary presents
  • Corporate events and team buildings
  • Other location‑specific benefits
  • Not applicable for freelancers
